# ruff: noqa: F821
# graph_headroom — evolution seed for the dev-continuum-* family.  Identity stays
# outside EVOLVE-BLOCKs; Shinka operators may change only the implementation below.
#
# Why this seed and not `least_allocated` (the dev-medium-hot seed): on this family the
# dependency-blind policies are *infeasible* (worst SLO 0.88 against a 0.90 target), so
# seeding from one would start every arm outside the feasible region and turn the first
# half of every campaign into a feasibility hunt rather than a search.  This seed is the
# most SLO-margined feasible hand-written policy (0.95); it is also the *expensive* one
# (1.27 normalized energy against `latency_greedy`'s 0.83), which is deliberate — the
# search starts feasible and has an explicit, large energy gap to close rather than
# starting at the best baseline with nowhere to go.
POLICY_NAME: str = "graph_headroom"

# ruff: noqa: F821
# graph_headroom — evolution seed for the dev-continuum-* family.  Identity stays
# outside EVOLVE-BLOCKs; Shinka operators may change only the implementation below.
#
# Why this seed and not `least_allocated` (the dev-medium-hot seed): on this family the
# dependency-blind policies are *infeasible* (worst SLO 0.88 against a 0.90 target), so
# seeding from one would start every arm outside the feasible region and turn the first
# half of every campaign into a feasibility hunt rather than a search.  This seed is the
# most SLO-margined feasible hand-written policy (0.95); it is also the *expensive* one
# (1.27 normalized energy against `latency_greedy`'s 0.83), which is deliberate — the
# search starts feasible and has an explicit, large energy gap to close rather than
# starting at the best baseline with nowhere to go.
POLICY_NAME: str = "graph_headroom"
POLICY_VERSION: str = "1.0.0"

# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
def _pod_latency(pod_id: int, node_idx: int, state: ClusterState, graph: CallGraphCtx) -> float:
    total = 0.0
    m = len(graph.src)
    for e in range(m):
        s = graph.src[e]
        d = graph.dst[e]
        other = -1
        if s == pod_id:
            other = d
        if d == pod_id:
            other = s
        if other >= 0 and other != pod_id:
            neighbor = state.pods[other]
            if neighbor.current_node >= 0:
                total += graph.rate[e] * state.nodes[node_idx].latency_to_ms[neighbor.current_node]
    return total


def score(pod: Pod, node: NodeState, ctx: ClusterCtx) -> float:
    total = 0.0
    m = len(ctx.graph.src)
    for e in range(m):
        s = ctx.graph.src[e]
        d = ctx.graph.dst[e]
        other = -1
        if s == pod.id:
            other = d
        if d == pod.id:
            other = s
        if other >= 0 and other != pod.id:
            neighbor = ctx.pods[other]
            if neighbor.current_node >= 0:
                total += ctx.graph.rate[e] * node.latency_to_ms[neighbor.current_node]
    cpu_util = float(node.cpu_allocated) / float(node.cpu_capacity)
    margin = node.power_max_w - node.power_idle_w
    packed = cpu_util * margin
    return packed - total


def propose_moves(state: ClusterState, graph: CallGraphCtx, budget: int) -> list[Move]:
    out: list[Move] = []
    if budget <= 0:
        return out
    moved = 0
    n = len(state.pods)
    for i in range(n):
        if moved >= budget:
            return out
        p = state.pods[i]
        placed = p.current_node >= 0
        movable = placed and not p.stateful and not p.has_pdb
        if movable:
            src = state.nodes[p.current_node]
            src_util = float(src.cpu_allocated) / float(src.cpu_capacity)
            best = -1
            best_util = src_util + 0.15
            k = len(state.nodes)
            for j in range(k):
                nd = state.nodes[j]
                usable = (not nd.suspended) and j != p.current_node
                if usable:
                    u = float(nd.cpu_allocated) / float(nd.cpu_capacity)
                    if u > best_util:
                        best_util = u
                        best = j
            if best >= 0:
                cur_lat = _pod_latency(p.id, p.current_node, state, graph)
                new_lat = _pod_latency(p.id, best, state, graph)
                ok = new_lat <= cur_lat * 1.5 + 1.0
                if ok:
                    out.append(move_pod(p.id, best))
                    moved += 1
    return out
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END
